(1)For the purpose of this Clause SCC7.306 of the Special Conditions of Contract, “Wall Tiling Works” means tiles and tile fixing systems fixed or installed to or on walls and columns of any buildings or structures, including such associated fins, projections, recesses, beams, features, skirting and the like and such other areas, surfaces or locations as shown on the Drawings with tile fixing systems designed by the Contractor. The tile fixing systems shall include but not be limited to all necessary preparatory works, spatterdash, beds, screeds, renderings, grouting, slurries, adhesives, bonding agents, fixings and the like for the fixing or installation of the tiles.

(2)The Contractor shall unconditionally warrant to the Employer that he shall at his own expense repair, rectify, or make good any defect of the Wall Tiling Works as may be identified to him for a period of five years commencing from the day which is two years from the date of completion stated in the certificate of completion issued under Clause 8.7 of the General Conditions of Contract. Where there is more than one such certificate of completion, the 5-year period of warranty for the Wall Tiling Works of or in the buildings or structures shall commence from the day which is two years from the date of completion stated in the certificate of completion in respect of such buildings or structures. The Contractor shall, at his own expense, carry out such work of repair or rectification, or make good any defect of the Wall Tiling Works as soon as practicable upon notification by the Employer.

inputEvidence.quote: Wall tiling warranty required: Yes

(1)The Contractor may apply for a one-off advance payment in accordance with the provisions of this Clause SCC14.305 of the Special Conditions of Contract.
